Title: Partial Pages
Body: Partial Pages or Views are Razor files containing snippets of HTML and server-side code to be included in any number of pages or layouts. Partial pages can be used to break up complex pages into smaller units, thereby reducing the complexity and allowing teams to work on different units concurrently.

Title: HTML Style
Body: The HTML style attribute is used to add styles to an element, such as color, font, size, and more.
